items.title: GitHub Makes Agentic Workflows Generally Available with Isolation and Budget Controls
items.summaryShort: GitHub Makes Agentic Workflows Generally Available with Isolation and Budget Controls. GitHub Agentic Workflows is generally available, running coding agents in GitHub Actions with read-only defaults and separately scoped write jobs.

items.title: JioHotstar Benchmarks Knowledge Bases for AI Coding Agents
items.summaryShort: JioHotstar Benchmarks Knowledge Bases for AI Coding Agents. JioHotstar evaluated 6 approaches to code retrieval for AI coding agents using SWE, CodeScale Bench, and an internal question-answering harness.

items.title: Presentation: Uncorking Queueing Bottlenecks with OpenTelemetry
items.summaryShort: Presentation: Uncorking Queueing Bottlenecks with OpenTelemetry. Oli Lane and Julian Wreford share how Gearset replaced guesswork in distributed asynchronous queues with OpenTelemetry tracing.

items.title: Article: The iOS Crash We Could Not Reproduce
items.summaryShort: Article: The iOS Crash We Could Not Reproduce. This article describes the investigation to find the root cause of a production crash in a large-scale iOS consumer app that had no clean stack trace.

items.title: OpenAI's quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
